# HypeMuzik

> A desktop and mobile audio player built around a 31-band graphic equalizer and
> a 12-stage DSP chain, with phone-to-desktop audio streaming.

HypeMuzik runs the same sound engine on macOS, Windows, Linux, Android and iOS.
The desktop app processes system-wide audio, not just its own playback.

## Product
- [Home](https://hypemuzik.com/): features, the signal chain, and downloads.
- [Desktop releases](https://github.com/Lw-Muzik/hype-dsp/releases/latest): macOS (universal .dmg), Windows (.exe/.msi), Linux (AppImage/.deb/.rpm).
- [iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hypemuzik-dsp/id6760889647)
- [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=x.a.zix)

## Key facts
- 31-band graphic equalizer at ISO third-octave centres (20 Hz – 20 kHz).
- 12-stage DSP chain, in order: headphone correction, graphic EQ, bass boost,
  spatializer, 3D surround, room reverb, convolution IR, multiband compander,
  tube saturation, script processor, makeup gain, brickwall limiter.
- 3,938 bundled AutoEq headphone profiles.
- Stem separation, synced karaoke lyrics, internet radio and TV, cloud
  libraries (Google Drive, Dropbox) and YouTube Music.
- Phone Link streams a phone's library through the desktop's DSP chain over the
  local network, with no cloud intermediary.
